home_meta_title: Utsuwa: Open-Source AI Companion with 3D VRM Avatars
home_meta_description: Open-source AI companion with 3D VRM avatars, voice chat, semantic memory, and support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and local LLMs. Desktop app and web. Self-hosted, privacy-first.
home_meta_description_short: Open-source AI companion with 3D VRM avatars, voice chat, semantic memory, and support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and local LLMs.
hero_title_full: Give your AI a body, a voice, a memory, and a home.
hero_alt_tsuki: Tsuki, a 3D VRM companion with long purple hair, looking at you
hero_alt_avatar_c: A 3D VRM companion with dark hair and a high-collared jacket, looking at you
hero_lede: Utsuwa is a free, open-source AI companion with a 3D VRM avatar, voice chat, and memory that lasts. Bring your own keys or run it fully offline.
letter_title: We built the body. You decide what fills it.
letter_body: Most AI lives in a text box and forgets you by morning. Utsuwa gives yours a face, a voice, and a memory, on your own keys or fully offline, with nothing routed through us.
mark_note: 器, utsuwa: a vessel. Traditionally read as four containers with a dog keeping watch.
sc_presence_title: Not a chat window. Someone in the room.
sc_presence_sub: Load any VRM avatar and they breathe, look around, and answer out loud with lip-synced voice. Replies float up as speech bubbles that follow them as they move.
sc_presence_alt: Tsuki, a 3D VRM companion, sitting on a wooden stool
sc_msg_1: you've been quiet today. rough meeting?
sc_msg_3: you only say "it's fine" three times when it isn't
sc_msg_4: want to vent, or should i distract you with that ramen place you saved?
sc_memory_sub: Your people, your plans, the little things you only mention once. Local embeddings weave every chat into memories they recall by meaning, and your bond grows across eight stages, from Stranger to Soulmate.

sc_own_title: Free, open source, and entirely yours
features_title: Made to play with, not just talk to
feature_custom_body: Drop in any VRM from VRoid Hub or Booth, or start with Tsuki, Yuki, or Momo.
feature_custom_alt: Momo, Tsuki, and Yuki, three 3D VRM companions, posing together around a stool
feature_ar_body: Stand them on your real floor through the camera in Android Chrome or any WebXR headset, and keep chatting the whole time.
feature_ar_alt: A phone showing a VRM companion standing in a real hallway through the camera
feature_photo_body: Pick a pose, frame the shot, drop in stickers, and save it. Your camera roll is about to get cuter.
stories_title: Built in the open, one post at a time
stories_quip_2: you should see the first draft

app_chat_image_unreadable: Couldn't read that image. Try a different one.
app_chat_image_unsupported: That image format isn't supported. Try a JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP (iPhone HEIC photos won't work).
app_chat_vision_hint: This model can't see images. If it can, switch on Can see images in Settings > LLM Model. Otherwise pick a vision model or turn on a separate one there.
app_chat_privacy_local: Photos you show her stay on your machine. They never leave this device.
app_chat_privacy_remote: Photos you show her are sent to {provider} so she can see them. They're also saved on this device; delete them anytime from the board.
app_chat_drop_photo: Drop a photo to show her
app_chat_clear_confirm: Delete all messages in this chat?
app_board_description: Photos you've shared with your companion.
app_board_empty_hint: Show her a photo and she'll keep it here.
app_board_flip_description: Flip the photo to see its note.
app_board_no_note: She hasn't said much about this one… yet.
app_board_flip_hint: Click the photo to flip it over
app_stage_stranger_desc: You just met. She is polite but guarded.
app_stage_acquaintance_desc: She is starting to warm up to you.
app_stage_friend_desc: She is comfortable around you and enjoys your company.
app_stage_close_friend_desc: She trusts you deeply and shares her thoughts freely.
app_stage_romantic_interest_desc: There is something more between you...
app_stage_dating_desc: You are together now. She is openly affectionate.
app_stage_committed_desc: Deep commitment and love. Partners in everything.
app_common_copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the message text to copy it manually.
app_onboarding_description: A few short steps. Chat and voice can be set up later.
app_onboarding_welcome: A few gentle steps to bring your companion to life.
app_onboarding_mode_subtitle: You can change this anytime in settings.
app_onboarding_mode_dating_desc: A relationship that grows over time: moods, events, and eight stages.
app_onboarding_mode_companion_desc: A friendly assistant for conversation and everyday help.
app_onboarding_name_subtitle: Give your AI companion a name and a personality.
app_onboarding_personality_placeholder: Describe their personality, speaking style, background...
app_onboarding_personality_hint: This shapes how your companion talks and behaves.
app_onboarding_avatar_subtitle: Select a VRM model or upload your own.
app_services_chat_subtitle: Choose the service that powers your conversations. You can connect it later in Settings.
app_services_voice_subtitle: Add spoken replies, or keep things quiet for now.
app_services_local_no_key: Local provider, no API key needed
app_services_base_url_hint: Enter a base URL to fetch available models.
app_services_local_no_key_dash: Local provider - no API key needed
app_services_voice_off: Enable to add voice to your companion
app_services_mic_hint: You can use the microphone button to speak instead of type. Transcription options live in Settings.
app_services_keys_note: Provider keys save on this device. Requests go to the provider you choose.
app_onboarding_ready: Your companion is ready for a conversation.
app_onboarding_ready_no_chat: Your companion is set up. Connect a chat model in Settings when you are ready to talk.
app_language_desc: Follow your device or pick a language. The app reloads to apply it.

app_nav_kw_display: appearance theme light dark language chat typing screen awake layout
app_nav_kw_animations: vrma emote gesture upload motion library idle thinking

app_display_intro: Choose your appearance and how conversations appear on screen.
app_display_color_theme_desc: Choose a theme or follow your device's appearance.
app_display_layout_desc: Show replies beside your companion or in a docked chat window.
app_display_dock_desc: Dock beside the avatar on wide screens, or below it on small screens.
app_display_bar_desc: Where the input bar sits along the bottom edge.
app_display_reveal_desc: How quickly replies appear. Off shows the full response immediately.
app_display_wait_tone_desc: Soft audio ping while the typing indicator is visible.
app_display_delay_desc: Wait before the typing dots appear.
app_display_awake_desc: Keep the display on while Utsuwa is visible. This can use more battery.
app_display_awake_unsupported: Not supported in this browser or desktop webview.
app_display_awake_active: Active. The display is staying awake.
app_display_awake_requesting: Requesting permission to keep the display awake...
app_display_awake_inactive: Inactive. Your browser or device released or declined the request.
app_display_awake_off: Off. Your normal display timeout applies.
app_display_mood_desc: Her face reflects her current mood. Turn this off if your model's expressions read too strong.
app_display_mouth_desc: How far her mouth opens when she talks. Lower it if your model's mouth opens too wide, raise it if it barely moves.
app_display_moments_desc: Let her write anniversary and story moments from what you have shared, in your language. Off plays the built-in scenes.
app_persona_intro: Shape your companion's identity, or see how they're doing.
app_persona_personality_desc: How your companion speaks, behaves, and sees the world. Changes save when you leave the field.
app_persona_system_prompt_desc: Replaces the built-in framing and rules at the top of every prompt, in both modes. Leave it empty to use the default.
app_persona_macros_hint: {char} becomes your companion's name and {user} becomes "the user", here and in Personality. Memory, mood, and the reply format are still added after this.
app_persona_mode_desc: Dating sim includes relationship progression and events. Companion focuses on everyday conversation.
app_persona_mode_confirm_desc: This changes whether relationship progression and events are active. Your companion's name and personality stay the same.
app_persona_reset_desc: Your custom system prompt will be cleared and the built-in one used again. Personality is not affected.
app_persona_upload_desc: Choose a VRM avatar file from your device.
app_persona_state_desc: The same live view you'll find beside the chat input. These values change as you spend time together.
app_persona_achievements_desc: Moments you've shared with your companion.
app_persona_achievements_empty: No achievements yet. They'll appear here as your relationship grows.
app_llm_intro: Configure the chat model and provider settings.
app_llm_guessed_on: Guessed from the model name. Turn this off if photos fail.
app_llm_guessed_off: Guessed from the model name. Turn this on if the model takes images.
app_llm_vision_desc: Let a different model look at photos for your chat model.
app_llm_max_tokens_hint: Hard limit for the number of tokens in the response. Leave empty to use the provider default.
app_llm_presence_hint: Reduces repetition of tokens already used.
app_llm_frequency_hint: Stronger penalty for frequently repeated tokens.
app_llm_vision_off: Off. Photos go to your chat model. Turn this on to have another model describe them instead, and your chat model replies from that description. Useful when the chat model can't see images, or its image tokens cost more.
app_llm_chat_off: Turn on chat to pick a provider and model.
app_context_note: When enabled, memory injection and chat history are scaled to fit the selected model's context window.
app_tts_intro: Configure the voice provider and speech settings.
app_tts_off: Turn on speech to pick a voice provider.
app_stt_intro: Configure speech-to-text providers and the local server timeout.
app_stt_cloud_desc: A local server is used first, then Groq, then OpenAI, then the browser's built-in recognition. Required on desktop, which has no built-in recognition.
app_stt_local_desc: Speaches, faster-whisper-server, whisper.cpp, or any OpenAI-compatible transcription endpoint.
app_stt_timeout_hint: How long to wait for the server to transcribe. Raise this for slow or CPU-only machines.
app_anim_intro: Motions she can perform. Describe each one so she knows when to use it.
app_anim_intro_play: Play switches back to your companion to show the motion.
app_anim_base_desc: How she moves when nothing else is happening. Talking keeps the built-in motion.
app_anim_idle_desc: She cycles through the checked motions at random.
app_anim_idle_keep: Keep at least one idle motion.
app_anim_thinking_desc: Plays while she is working on a reply, before the first words arrive.
app_anim_empty: No custom animations yet. Upload a .vrma file to add one.
app_anim_description_placeholder: What does this motion look like?
app_vrm_upload_hint: Drag & drop or click to browse
